channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Tell HN: Cloudflare silently injects its analytics when you switch nameservers
Cloudflare Turns CI Pipelines into TypeScript Workflows
item.description: Cloudflare has released cloudflare/ci, a CI SDK that defines pipelines in TypeScript on top of Cloudflare Workflows, giving each step durable retries and replay, concurrent steps by default and Sandbox snapshot caching. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports MariaDB 12.3
item.description: Starting today, Amazon RDS for MariaDB supports MariaDB major version 12.3, the latest Long-Term Support release from the MariaDB community. This release supports MariaDB 12.3.2 minor version. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Marketplace now supports category-based notification subscriptions and multi-channel delivery for buyers
item.description: AWS Marketplace buyers can now configure category-based notifications and multi-channel delivery through AWS User Notifications. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Identity and Access Management streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users with account access manager
item.description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) launched account access manager, a feature that streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports up to 10,000 collections per collection group
item.description: The next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports up to 10,000 collections within a single collection group, increased from the previous limit of 1,500. (1 source: aws)
